displayDetailReview.reason: Replace only selected pre-existing NE modern coastal proxy arcs using exact current-donor vertices and separately identified in-segment intersections. parameters.intersectionPolicy: Exact rational intersection over stored binary doubles, then native-double representation. Calculated points are not copied donor vertices. Nonzero native-floating line residuals are recorded, not snapped or relabeled exact.
parameters.sourceVersionCoverage: Unchanged existing representative-display interval; no claim that historical coastlines or political ownership were constant throughout it.

displayDetailReview.counterpartCoverage: Bounded actual source intervals only. Current LTU/POL/DNK comparisons remain technical spatial checks; they do not fill missing historical periods.
displayDetailReview.reviewScope: Source-only limited modern-coast substitution, not historical accuracy, licensing clearance, compiled data or runtime approval.

periodEvidence.startEvent: Formation of the dual government selected as the registration event. The 1867 settlement had several constitutional and legislative stages; this date is a documented modeling choice, not the date of every stage.
periodEvidence.endEvent: Dissolution of the dual union; treated as the first date outside the old identity.

representativeReuse.reviewScope: Fresh source-only modern-coast island display delta reviewed for the unchanged provisional display period. Historical correctness across the period and compiled interval outputs are not established.
representativeReuse.peerOwnership: Date-only local availability update; no peer clipping or neighboring geometry regeneration performed.

modernCoastArcReuse.previousReviewDisposition: Any previously embedded display receipt applies only to its archived prior geometry; no prior pass is transferred. Previous adopted-island provenance remains unchanged.
